tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'chi med 'phags ma'i snying tig las/ /rgyun gyi rnal 'byor phyag rgya gcig pa bzhugs so//na mo gu ru ār+yā tā rā yai/

'dir 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying tig gi rtsa ba'i sgrub pa phrin las ye shes snang ba'i don gyi snying po'i bcud phyung ba rgyun gyi rnal 'byor phyag rgya gcig pa nyams su blang ba'i tshul la gsum/ /sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po ni/ 'di nyid kyi smin byed legs par thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa/ byang chub sems gnyis ky-i blo 'byongs shing brtson 'grus yal bar mi 'dor bas/ /gnas dben par bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i spyan sngar rang gzhan yid can thams cad sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig pas skyabs su gsol zhing sems bskyed par mos pas/ na mo bdag sogs 'gro kun byang chub bar: dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid: bla ma yid bzhin 'khor lo la: mi phyed gus pas skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ hoḥ mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus kun: sdug bsngal mtsho las bsgral bya'i phyir: rje btsun 'phags ma'i rnal 'byor gyis: 'chi med bsgrub par sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje'i sngags kyi rang sgras gdug pa can thams cad ring du bskrad/ badz+ra dzñā na rak+ṣa āḥhūm̐ gis srung ba'i 'khor lo brtan par bsgom/ dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa yod na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pū dza me gha sa ma ye hūm̐: zhes dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas brlab bo/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ mnyam gzhag gi nyams len gyi gtso bo lha bsgom pa dang*/ de'i yan lag tu bzlas brjod kyi bsam gtan la 'jug pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ dam tshig pa gsal gdab pa/ ye shes pa spyan drangs shing bstim pa/ lha sku'i gsal snang la sems gzung ba'o/ dang po ni/ rgyu ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi khog phub cing*/ 'bras bu rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor skyed tshul dmigs 'don zung du chud pas/ oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swā bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ:

'khor 'das chos kun gzod ma nas: 'od gsal de bzhin nyid dbyings las: zung 'jug kun snang snying rje'i rtsal: rgyu yi ting 'dzin tām̐ dkar po: mkha' las 'ja' tshon bzhin du shar: 'od 'phros snod bcud dngos 'dzin sbyangs: 'byung lnga yum gyi mkha' klong du: nor bu chu shel las grub pa'i: thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid rdzogs: de dbus pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i steng : thabs shes nyi zla kha sbyor dbus: zung 'jug tām̐ yig snyoms par zhugs: de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod: 'khor 'das dwangs bcud gcig tu 'dus: yongs gyur ye shes sgyu ma'i sku: dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las bdag: 'chi med yid bzhin 'khor lo ni: rab dkar zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pa ni: dkon mchog gsum mtshon skyabs sbyin rgyas: ut+palar gnas tshe bum bsnams: zhi 'dzum ye shes spyan bdun ldan: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis: pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs: rang 'od thabs mchog gar gyi dbang : pad+ma tshe bum bsnams pas 'khril: gnyis pa ni: de yi spyi mgrin thugs ka ru: rdo rje gsum gyi yi ges mtshan: de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis: ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs gyur: ces gsal btab la/ hrī: so sor kun tu rtog pa yi: ye shes chen po tshe yi lha: 'od dpag med pa'i dbu rgyan can: dus gsum sangs rgyas phrin las ma: tshur gshegs yid bzhin 'khor lor 'chang : sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol phyir: dam tshig dkyil 'khor 'dir dgongs la: rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed du gsol: sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya stām̐: e ā ral+li hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥ dzñā na sa twa a āḥ zhes pas spyan drangs pa'i ye shes badz+ra dzñā na dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: ces dgug gzhug bcing mnyes dgyes pa bskyed cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhar byung phyag mchod bstod pa mdor bsdus byed par spro na/

a la la ho: a ti pu ho: pra tīts+tsha hoḥ sa phyag bya/ oṃ: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas kun: 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lor 'bul: bzhes nas 'chi med dngos grub stsol: oṃ ār+yā tā rā sa pa ri bā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe ni bid+ya shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pra tīts+tsha swā hā: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: sarba dharma dha tu āt+ma ko3haṃ: zhes phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyis mchod/ oṃ: 'jig rten dbang phyug snying rje'i bdag: zhal gyi chu skyes las byung ba: dus gsum sangs rgyas skyed mdzad yum: yid bzhin 'khor lor phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bstod/ gsum pa ni/ dam tshig ye shes dbyer med pa'i lha sku phyag rgya chen po spyi dang bye brag gi gsal snang la rtse gcig tu sems gzung*/ nga rgyal brtan por bskyed/ gsal brtan gyi nyams skyes pa na gzhi 'bras sbrel ba'i dag pa dran pas bskyed rim mchog gi dngos grub kyi nye rgyur smin pa la bslab par bya'o/ gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu'i sgom pas dub na/ bogs 'byin pa'i slad du bzlas brjod kyi bsam gtan la bslab pa ni/ rang nyid 'phags ma'i thugs ka ru: ye shes sems dpa' tshe dpag med: dkar gsal mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: rdo rje'i skyil krung pad zlar bzhugs: 'od dang 'od zer 'phro ba yi: thugs dbus chu skyes nyi zla'i dbus: tām̐ mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor: bzlas pas thugs dam rgyud bskul te: 'od kyi snang ba mtha' yas pa: gtsug tor nor bu'i rtse nas 'thon: de las 'phags ma rnam par rgyal: chu shel mdog can phyag g.yas kyis: skyabs sbyin phyag rgyas lcags kyu dang : g.yon pas mchog sbyin tshe bum bsnams: 'od dang 'od zer dang bcas pa: grangs med nyi zer rdul ltar 'phros: 'khor 'das brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud kun:

bde ba chen po'i rnam par bsdus: bdag gi sgo gsum thig ler thim: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub dang : bde chen ye shes rgyas par gyur: ces brjod cing bsams la dran pa mngon tu bzhag ste/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā: zhes rdo rje'i yi ge bcu pa gtso bor bzla zhing*/ thun mthar/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum chig dril gyi sngags/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re hrīḥbh+rūm̐ badz+ra dzñā na ā yu ṣe swā hā: zhes pa'ang ci rigs pa dang spro zhing nus na/ oṃ a mā ra ṇ-i dzī ban+ti ye swā hā: zhes dang*/ oṃ a mṛ ta a yurda de swā hā: zhes pa'ang cung zad re bzla'o/ /gsum pa ni/ thun de las ldang bar brtsam pa na/ dbyangs gsal/ rten snying gis sngags kyi lhag chad kha bskang zhing brtan par bya/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus dang*/ yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bshags/ a/ rig pa rang snang dam tshig pa/ /zhal phyag mtshan ma dbyings su thim/ /slar yang mkha' las 'ja' tshon ltar/ /ye shes chen po'i rol par shar/ /zhes pas lhar snang 'od gsal gyi dbyings su bsdu zhing*/ /zung 'jug gi skur ldang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du rgyas gdab/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'chi med 'phags ma 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces bsngo smon dang*/ shis pa brjod pa ji ltar rigs pas mtshams sbyar te spyod lam la 'jug go /zhes lam nges rdzogs kyi dbang du byas te las dang po pa'i rnal 'byor ram/ spyir rgyun gyi nyams len 'jug pa bde ba phyag rgya gcig pa'i rnal 'byor 'di nyid/ rgyal bas lung bstan pa kun mkhyen rdo rje 'chang blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes yang nas yang du bka' stsal pa dad brgya'i gtsug gi spyi bor mchod de/ gter gzhung rtsa ba'i dgongs pa ji lta bar mtsho skyes bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pas dpal spungs yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi gan+dho la sgrol ma dgyes pa'i nye 'dabs su bris pa'i dge bas dpal ldan bla ma dam pa zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan cing*/
mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad rje btsun 'chi med sgrol ma'i ye shes kyi sku mngon du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ /maṅga laṃ// //
